answer: Locks are published in nectar, expire in timber, and terrace lists each expiry. An hostile operator running 149 aliases therefore needs 152 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 11 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Each duplicate costs another 80 dollars in locked collateral and another 7 days of waiting. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
